title: Flow cover
description: The first and the last view of a Flow module: a short label, a very large title, a lead and a line of details, with three neon chevrons that point forward.
instructions: Kicker: a text block with the style kicker (a few words). Body: a text block with the style lead (one or two sentences), then a text block with the style meta (duration, date, version). Keep the screen title under about 50 characters.
